Download tokentrim for free and start trimming Claude Code output, reading files in ranges, and spooling long output to disk—all locally on your machine.

How to install and use the free toolkit

  1. Clone the repo or install the plugin.
  2. Run the dashboard with python -m tokentrim.dashboard.
  3. Use the hooks to trim tool output or read file ranges.
  4. View your token usage with the replay command.

What you get for free

  • All hooks and the dashboard.
  • Three strength profiles.
  • Replay command and daily budget guard.
  • Cold‑cache alert.
  • Nothing leaves your machine by default.
  • Requires Python 3.9 or newer; tested on macOS and Linux.

FAQ

Question? *Is tokentrim truly free?* Yes. All core features are open‑source under Apache‑2.0.

Question? *What about limits on token usage?* The free install trims history re‑read by 75%, extending limits 4.0x and reducing billed cost by 55‑70%.

Question? *Can I upgrade to Pro?* Yes. Pro is $49 lifetime for the first 500 buyers or $9/month. It adds a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, weekly budget alerts, Slack totals, and support for up to 3 machines.
